title: Stable, but a hassle to store.
text: Stable, but a hassle to store.. When it's set, it's set. It's stable and does a great job holding whatever is on there (whether food, a laptop, or a racing gig). Unfolding it requires squeezing one of the legs from under the table. Then it all unfolds and is ready to store. But there's no locking mechanism to prevent the legs from slipping out. While there are grips on the legs to prevent the table from falling, the table requires certain angles so it doesn't fall over.

product_metadata.title: Flash Furniture Elon Folding Table - Granite White - Height Adjustable - 26 Inch - TV Tray - Commercial Grade Laptop Table
features: Plastic folding adjustable height table suitable for either commercial or residential spaces; Ideal for outdoor events like tailgating and camping
INDOOR/OUTDOOR: High density polyethylene top does not break down from sun exposure; Impact and water resistant
DURABLE & LOW-MAINTENANCE: Welded joints and metal screw construction with a powder coated steel frame; supports up to 50 lbs. static weight capacity; Clean with a water based cleaner
ADJUSTABILITY: No Assembly Required: adjustable frame adjusts in three increments
PRODUCT MEASUREMENTS: Overall Size: 25.5"W x 17.75"D x 21-27"H; Folding Size: 39"W x 18"D x 2.5"H
description: If you need extra surface space in your office cubicle, classroom, training room, dorm room, or in the home, this adjustable height personal folding table may be just what you're looking for. The granite white top gives a clean and tidy appearance to any space and adjusts from 20.8"H to 27"H to accommodate a variety of tasks. Pick one of the three height adjustment grooves and raise the tab to lock the frame in place. Lightweight for easy transport and suitable for indoor/outdoor use, this commercial grade table would be an excellent addition to any space. Use this handy piece as a laptop table while sitting on the floor to craft your term paper, a TV tray to watch your favorite show during dinner, or as a companion desk in your workspace without worry. Welded joints, metal screw construction and a gray powder coated steel frame provide a stable base to support up to 50 lbs. static weight capacity. The high density polyethylene top is ultra-strong and durable and does not break down from sun exposure so it's ideal for camping or tailgating. This multi-use side table needs no assembly and folds flat for convenient storage and transportation. A water based cleaner quickly cleans up spills and removes dust. Fixed plastic floor glides will prevent damage to your hard flooring surfaces.
